scope: Native numerical-accuracy sensitivity at fixed points from an already qualified measurement. Not a posterior correction, convergence proof, model comparison or new physical target.
context: The separate earlier fixed-reference/holdout native_precision_audit was known when this screen was declared. These thresholds are diagnostic choices, not calibrated confidence guarantees.
selection: Within each qualified native-correction chain, order by original expanded_index and select floor((j+0.5)*N/8), j=0..7. No selection using likelihood errors or extreme weights. Preserve repeated physical points if present; report distinct identities.
physical_invariance: Same physical/nuisance coordinates, complete likelihood components, priors, data, flatness, neutrinos, halofit, lens_potential_accuracy4, lens_margin and multipole requirements. Only the three numerical controls change. No emulator evaluation or acoustic-coordinate reinversion.
center_definition: Unweighted mean of the32 high-minus-declared full log-likelihood differences. A common offset cancels from normalized weights; finite variation matters. These32 chronological strata are not a representative weighted posterior sample.
threshold_interpretation: A total maximum centered difference <=0.1 implies pairwise relative likelihood changes no larger than exp(0.2) among these tested points only. Component flags detect large cancellations. Passing is only no large variation detected on this finite screen; failure requests further accuracy investigation. No gate on common offset alone.
background: A declared-accuracy background-only reconstruction from the native CAMB Params is checked against stored rdrag, omegam, q/j. Compare H, thetaMC and recombination quantities between accuracy settings; this adds no native spectra. Preserve finalized CAMB requirements and distinguish Params.max_l from padded provider Dl length.
failure_policy: Retain every attempted point, exception and native log. Existing incomplete logs prohibit silent retry; completed caches require previous file hashes and canonical payload checks. No point replacement, clipping, 32-point reweighting or posterior-significance inference.
limitations: Two accuracy levels do not establish asymptotic convergence.32 deterministic strata may miss tails, localized errors and remote modes. Stored baseline spectra are unavailable; full baseline component likelihoods are available. Higher-accuracy spectra are archived for later diagnosis only. Existing posterior qualification remains separate.
